i5630.title: [Access A1] Derive semantic names, roles and actions from exact Face and component Fores
i5630.body:
Parent #5367.

## Scope
Implement/verify checked accessible role/name/value/disabled/required details for offered actions, subjects and component slots across one real Todo/Commons Face.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Accessible name/action retains exact source subject and current revision.
- [ ] Missing required semantic slot or forged action refuses.
- [ ] Nonvisual generic fallback remains usable.

## Stop line
No app-provided ARIA overriding authoritative Face.

Depends on source Face #5355 and structured components #5365; controls and accessibility names must be derived from trusted semantics.

One focused PR should carry needed safety regressions and identify proof class.

i5631.title: [Access A2] Certify keyboard/focus interactions and stale action refusal
i5631.body:
Parent #5367.

## Scope
Map native/browser keyboard and pointer interactions to approved current typed FaceInteraction, including focus/reading order and stale Show rejection.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Keyboard-only navigation activates all required controls.
- [ ] Focus visible and independent of color-only styling.
- [ ] Stale/hidden/unauthorized action cannot mutate Body.

## Stop line
No alternate input authorization path.

Depends on source Face #5355 and structured components #5365; controls and accessibility names must be derived from trusted semantics.

One focused PR should carry needed safety regressions and identify proof class.

i5632.title: [Access A3] Prove hostile styling cannot conceal mandatory accessible controls
i5632.body:
Parent #5367.

## Scope
Adversarially render oversized content, forced colors, reduced motion, CSS override, hidden buttons and invalid component/Look contracts with actual browser checks where supported.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Required actions remain discoverable or render refuses.
- [ ] Long/Unicode text and zoom bounds tested.
- [ ] Browser runtime proof distinguished from static semantic validation.

## Stop line
Do not certify arbitrary unreviewed HTML/CSS as accessible.

Depends on source Face #5355 and structured components #5365; controls and accessibility names must be derived from trusted semantics.

One focused PR should carry needed safety regressions and identify proof class.

i5365.title: [Mask Components C1] Compose reusable component Plots through checked Fores
i5365.body:
Parent: #5354. Architectural prerequisite #5364 (separate structure from theme), conformance baseline #5355. This issue owns **component structure**, not brand styling and not app/domain meaning.

## Outcome
Let Conduit application authors publish reusable, named, checked component recipes (Todo card, instrument dial, Patchbay node, mathematics display, place navigator) against bounded projections of a Face. They should be ordinary Plot/Gear compositions with checked Fores before proposing any special component language. A checked Fore says **which meaning and typed actions the component consumes or returns**; its internal Plot and structural recipe say **how those meanings are composed and remain navigable**. It is not a new Body, Host, universal widget ontology, arbitrary HTML document, or independent Mask executor.

## Proposed contract (conceptual, not settled Conduitese syntax)
```text
ComponentRecipe<TaskCard>
  requires:
    item: Subject<todo/item> [name, completion flag]
    complete: Action<todo/complete>(target = item)
  structure:
    card {
      primary: item.name
      status: item.completion
      action-slot: complete
      detail: optional provenance disclosure
    }
  layout:
    slots, min/preferred/max sizes, overflow/flow, traversal order
    responsive alternatives that preserve required meaning and agency
  fallback:
    generic labelled action row
```
Do not assume an action that means one-way `complete` is a reversible checkbox or invent `reopen`. Slots and action bindings are validated against exact Face identities, typed constraints, current availability and disclosure. Unknown open semantic identities still admit a generic rendering and screen-free encounter.

## Scope
- Define portable bounded recipe ID/version/digest, import/selection, typed semantic slot matching, required vs optional content, default/fallback, composition tree and structural responsive alternatives (not a fixed central `ApplicationComponent` enum for all future domains).
- Support reusable nested/custom components, explicit slots, layout constraints and structural variants; validate absence, unknown/mismatched types, duplicate actions/slots, cycles and finite resource/depth bounds.
- Bind action affordances only to current Face action and validated Show interactions. Keyboard/focus order and required semantic content must remain recoverable by the platform accessibility lowering in companion issue.
- A recipe **does not contain RGB palette, typeface selection, border radius, decorative assets, global CSS, custom ARIA roles, arbitrary callback authority or raw DOM**. Look supplies paint/brand vocabulary via stable *typed style hooks*. Font metrics may require reflow without rewriting recipe structure.
- Migrate `ApplicationView`/`semantic_ui` callers to the canonical Face/component contracts; reuse conformance fixtures as migration proof, then retire old public adapters. A new parser keyword/author syntax requires separate reviewed language compatibility decision; begin with a bounded checked representation and samples before inventing grammar.

## Ownership
A new narrowly owned structural-recipe module adjacent to `semantics/presentation` (below Face), exemplar authoring under reviewed `plots/`/packages, native and browser consumers. Coordinate with #5357 native layout; no concurrent uncoordinated edits to `front_door` or core Face grammar.

## Acceptance
- [ ] A Todo card and a Patchbay gear component bind real source Face subjects/actions; generic fallback works with an unknown valid domain component.
- [ ] **The same recipe is rendered with two different valid Looks** without changed semantic/structural IDs, action wiring, required slots or traversal, while paint/geometry may reflow.
- [ ] A second recipe can use the same Look without copying structure.
- [ ] Missing semantic slot, forged action, wrong action target/argument, stale Show, hidden mandatory content, invalid cycle, excessive nesting, invalid responsive variant all refuse or fall back honestly.
- [ ] Native/browser/linear conformance reconstruct equivalent projected meanings; linear path never requires a card/sprite to function.
- [ ] Reviewable unit, conformance and actual-browser/native where supported proofs; full required lint/test gates.

## Stop line
No high-level markup toolkit implemented inside Face; no custom theme engine in this issue; no direct HTML/SVG/JS injection in the certified path. Look visual facet packaging is #5366 and accessibility compiler is #5367. Completing this component system is a separate product extension and **must not block the small first playable Commons #5360**.

## Fore-first correction / Parsec regression (2026-10-09)
**Do not invent a `component` declaration simply because a UI is being built.** Test whether the existing ordinary `plot` / Kind / Fore / Gear architecture expresses it. A reusable Mask-local component can be a Plot with a typed Fore over projected source Face slots and currently offered `ActionRef` (conceptual) and outputs a bounded partial Show plus an exact `FaceInteraction` flow; the enclosing ordinary Mask owns final acknowledged Show. A newly proposed `ShowFragment` or typed Face projection is permissible only when a real existing value/Fore cannot express the bound and its proof calls for one. No second component executor or universal `Button` Kind.

Three independent concepts in the Parsec test (#5369): `game/start` is the semantic action; the Fire switch/key is the currently selected input binding; the blinking "PRESS FIRE TO BEGIN" graphic is one Mask's display of that action. Other Masks can narrate or linearly render the same Start action. A **Look** (#5368) supplies appearance/voice/rhetorical style, separate from Fore and structural recipe. The same component Fore works with distinct Looks, and the same Look styles multiple components without choosing their actions or keyboard mappings.


## Reusable Fore implementation split: source checking versus Web Back
A component is an ordinary checked Plot/Fore; do not introduce a new `component` keyword solely for browser rendering. #5378 owns the first actual compiling `.conduit` partial-Face/projection/assembly specimen, deciding from exact existing Kinds whether tentative `FaceSlice`/`RenderPart` intermediate Types are needed. #5376 owns the browser-specific selected Back that produces a genuine Web Component. #5379 owns optional actual CSS styling of exposed parts; #5377 owns the new Look syntax. This C1 ticket fixes reusable typed semantic slots, action binding and structural recipe conformance only. Compact vs spacious are **Looks**, not a second component Fore or structural variant by default. First acceptance: the *same checked item-view Fore* in two density Looks and a generic screen-free fallback. A changing DOM/Shadow DOM implementation cannot grant another action or mutate Todo state.

---

## Thin delivery slices (2026-10-13)
- [ ] **C1** #5624: Specify bounded ordinary component Plot/Fore slots on one Todo Face
- [ ] **C2** #5625: Repeat component recipes for Todo and Patchbay without redefining semantics
- [ ] **C3** #5626: Prove same components across two Looks and accessible fallback

F0 #5364 Look/Face separation, F1 #5355 and mapping #5372 govern semantics. Real browser realization belongs to #5376.

Parent remains open until original complete proof, WIP #5520 applies.

i5372.title: [Mask M1] Specify checked Face-to-renderer interaction correspondence
i5372.body:
Parent: #5354. Related existing law: #4115 (an ordinary Plot serves as a Mask), #5355 (cross-Mask semantic conformance), #5364 (Face / component Fore / Look separation), #5365 (components as ordinary Plots with Fores), #5367 (accessible lowering), and #5369 (truthful device-to-action bindings). Read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/presenter-hourglass.md`, `docs/architecture/presentation-grammar-conformance.md` and current `semantics/presentation/src/{mask_plot.rs,mask_show.rs,face.rs}` before implementation.

## Design insight: two interlocking sides of a Mask

A Mask is not a second catalogue of meaning or a merely aesthetic renderer. It is an **ordinary, checked Plot whose Fore couples the authoritative, context-scoped Face to concrete presentation and interaction operations supported by the chosen Host**.

```text
  Body / resident Plot truth
             |
  Face: subjects, relationships,
        meaning, offered actions
             |
        [ MASK ]
   checked correspondence
     /                \
 visual/spoken/       actual input events
 linear realization    + current bindings
     |                  |
 admitted Show       typed FaceInteraction
     |                  |
     +--- correlated ---+
```

The coupling works in both directions **without making semantics bidirectionally owned**:
- **Forward:** a rendered control, prompt or other meaningful expression must derive from an exact Face subject/action/relationship, with the required label, state, availability, argument contract and encounter order preserved. Look styles the expression; Host capabilities select the actual mechanism.
- **Return:** an actionable renderer event (click, keyboard, controller, voice, etc.) resolves through an admitted current binding to the *same* Face action and yields Show/revision-scoped typed `FaceInteraction` for the ordinary checked execution path. A Mask cannot dispatch arbitrary Body mutations or invent actions.
- **Local-only operations:** focus movement, scroll, hover, animation and decorative drawing need not correspond to a Face *application* action. They may remain Mask-local, but cannot impersonate a source action or change domain truth.

**Important:** this is not a literal one-to-one bijection. One Face action may be realized by several media or gestures, and an expression may present multiple semantic facts. The invariant is *explicit, typed, inspectable provenance and preserved agency* for each meaningful binding, not equal counts of renderer and semantic operations.

## Task (design and narrow proof, not another UI runtime)

1. Inventory the present Mask Fore boundary (`face` in, `interaction` and `show` out), `MaskShow` correlations, offered `Presentation` actions, device-binding work (#5369), and the native/browser/linear/spoken event-to-action paths. Identify what is already checked and the exact unproved seam.
2. Specify a minimal **correspondence contract/witness** expressible through existing typed Fore/Plot/Plan/Play values if possible. Only propose a new type when a concrete failure cannot be expressed safely in those values. Separate output semantic coverage, host-specific presentation operations, input-event bindings, and Show acknowledgement.
3. Define checked lowering/admission: every *source-affecting* renderer operation is backed by a current offered action and typed arguments; required actionable semantics are reachable or explicitly refused/fallback; renderer-local effects have no hidden domain authority.
4. Specify update behavior for new Face revisions, remapped inputs, focus transitions, unsupported media, stale Show, lost Host and refusal. No stale binding may act after its admitted basis changes.
5. Prove with a bounded cross-Mask fixture rather than a new component language. Reuse #5355's harness and #5369's Parsec-like Start action, plus a reversible-value or Todo action to expose role and state mismatches.

## Acceptance

- [ ] A written mapping/ownership diagram and concrete examples show exact Face → renderer expression/host operation → Show and event → typed `FaceInteraction`, including which pieces are checked by existing code and which need implementation.
- [ ] One offered action has two independently admitted realizations (e.g., arcade text and spoken prompt) and two valid inputs (e.g., Fire and keyboard), with different Shows but correct correlated action identity and committed effect.
- [ ] An inaccessible painted pseudo-button, missing semantic action, forged action/args, stale Show/revision, outdated input binding, disabled action and misleading spoken instruction are rejected or given a truthful, reachable fallback.
- [ ] Mask-local focus/scroll/decorative operations remain possible without polluting Face with fake app actions or another global widget/Button taxonomy.
- [ ] Component Plot/Fores (#5365), Look (#5368), platform accessibility (#5367) and device mapping (#5369) stay separate from the correspondence law; no duplicated semantics or unverified raw DOM/ARIA callbacks.
- [ ] Tests and documentation preserve ordinary Plan/Play/Host/Boot identity and exact source/Show correlation. Any required production change is split into reviewable implementation tickets with named ownership.

## Stop line

Do **not** add a universal Button Kind, a new Mask-specific graph language, automatic bijection constraints, a second semantic tree, a new scheduler, or an unrestricted renderer callback path. Do not make this architecture ticket a prerequisite for the small first playable Commons (#5360): begin with precise contracts and a falsifiable fixture.


## First executable interlock: Todo component mapped to actual DOM
Concrete production candidates #5378 (source-checked Face item projection and Gear composition), #5376 (selected genuine Web Component Back), #5379 (CSS Look) and #5380 (spoken templates). The source action identity/revision ↔ selected component Fore ↔ actual browser action binding ↔ Show acknowledgement ↔ typed return interaction must be inspected as one bounded witness. **Not one-to-one by count**: an action may have native DOM button, keyboard and spoken affordances; the rule is exact typed provenance and no second action authority. Decorative CSS/animations/focus movement remain local, but may not disable required agency. The C3 source proof must not assume provisional `RenderPart` and `FaceSlice` are already canonical Types.

---

## Thin delivery slices (2026-10-13)
- [x] **M1** #5642: Pin checked Face→renderer operation and event→FaceInteraction mapping
- [x] **M2** #5643: Demonstrate one executable Todo action through actual DOM correspondence (accepted in #5836)
- [ ] **M3** #5644: Refuse forged, stale and inaccessible renderer controls with fallback

Cross-Mask semantic #5355 is foundation; component #5365 and input prompt #5369 consume the checked forward/reverse correspondence.

Defer dependent implementation until Foundation/Look/Fore contracts accepted, WIP #5520.
